_doc: Coding-agent CLIs the Blurt app can hand a recording to, headless. Read by agents.py and by the macOS app (BlurtRecorder: Agents.swift; a copy is bundled into Blurt.app/Contents/Resources). Order of `agents` = default fallback order; the user's order is config record.agents. A custom agent can be added in config record.agent_defs with the same fields. status: how to tell whether it is logged in without spending tokens — `args` run with a 15 s timeout, then: json_key (a bool in the first JSON object of the output) > creds_json ({path, keys}: the file exists and every key is empty → logged out) > logged_out (substrings) > ok_if (substrings, exit 0) > configured_if (regex: has credentials, can't verify them) > env_any / files_any (credentials in env / on disk) > otherwise ('logged_out' | 'unknown'). run: the headless command, {prompt} = the task text. verified: 'run' = a real headless run was checked, 'cli' = flags checked with --help only, 'docs' = from the CLI's documentation.
